title: paronychia capitata subsp. atlantica
intro: Paronychia capitata subsp. atlantica, commonly known as Sea purslane, is a perennial succulent plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Paronychia capitata subsp. atlantica include wound healing, soothing skin irritations, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
